Official master brand application icon of Luxraj.com. This original visual identity represents the parent brand and is shared across all Luxraj.com sub-brands, websites, applications, and associated digital products. Individual sub-brands maintain their own separate wordmarks while retaining the shared Luxraj.com master brand identity.
